verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference and tooling API. An API of this kind could plausibly let callers attach external MCP servers as tools, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents Morph's own MCP server, which exposes Morph's tools (edit_file, codebase_search) to clients like Claude Code. That is the server role, not consuming third-party MCP servers. No evidence shows Morph itself connecting to or using tools from user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
